location.zh: Brightway 公司，王經理辦公室

goal.en: Politely ask Ms. Wong for a letter of recommendation, with enough notice.
goal.zh: 提早並有禮貌地請王經理幫你寫推薦信。

background: manager's office in the afternoon, wooden desk with a closed laptop and a coffee mug, bookshelf with binders, potted plant, warm sunlight through blinds

intro.en: A week after the address mix-up, things are back to normal at Brightway.
intro.zh: 地址事件過了一週，Brightway 的一切恢復正常。

intro.en: You've found a job opening back in Taipei, and it asks for a reference letter. Ms. Wong's door is open.
intro.zh: 你找到一個台北的職缺，需要附推薦信。王經理的門正開著。

lines.en: Kai. Come in. What's on your mind?

choices.en: Do you have a minute? There's a favor I'd like to ask you.
choices.zh: 您有空嗎？我想請您幫個忙。
choices.tip: 請託前先問 Do you have a minute?，再預告 a favor，讓對方有心理準備。

choices.en: Hi. I need you to write me a recommendation letter by Friday.
choices.zh: 嗨，我需要您星期五前幫我寫一封推薦信。

lines.en: You NEED me to? Interesting way to ask for a favor.
lines.zh: 你「需要」我？這種請人幫忙的方式還真特別。

story.en: Ms. Wong agrees, but her eyebrows stay raised for the rest of the conversation. That letter might be a little shorter than you hoped.
story.zh: 王經理答應了，但整段對話眉毛都沒放下來。那封信可能會比你期待的短一點。

fail.why: I need you to... 聽起來像下命令，對主管請託要更委婉。先問 Do you have a minute? I have a favor to ask.。

choices.en: Sorry to disturb you. Can I ask you a help for one thing?
choices.zh: 不好意思打擾了，可以請您幫一件事嗎？

lines.en: Ask me a help? Sure... I think? What do you need?
lines.zh: Ask me a help？可以吧……我想？你需要什麼？

story.en: Ms. Wong spends a moment decoding your sentence. Not the polished first impression you wanted for this request.
story.zh: 王經理花了點時間解讀你的句子。對這次請託來說，不是你想要的漂亮開場。

fail.why: 「請你幫個忙」不能說 ask you a help。可以說 Can I ask you a favor? 或 There's a favor I'd like to ask.。

lines.en: Of course. Have a seat. What is it?

choices.en: I was wondering if you'd be willing to write me a reference letter.
choices.zh: 我在想，不知道您是否願意幫我寫一封推薦信。
choices.tip: I was wondering if you'd be willing to... 是最客氣的請託句型，過去式讓語氣更委婉。

choices.en: I was wondering if you are willing write a reference letter for me.
choices.zh: 我在想您願不願意幫我寫一封推薦信。

lines.en: Willing... write? I think I'm missing a word there.
lines.zh: Willing write？我好像漏聽了一個字。

story.en: Ms. Wong figures it out, but she starts wondering how carefully you'll proofread your job application.
story.zh: 王經理聽懂了，但她開始擔心你的求職文件會不會也沒校對。

fail.why: be willing 後面要接 to + 原形動詞：willing to write。句型 I was wondering if 後面也建議搭配 you'd，語氣更客氣。

choices.en: I already wrote a recommendation letter myself. Could you just sign it?
choices.zh: 我已經自己寫好推薦信了，您簽個名就好。

lines.en: You wrote my letter for me? That's not really how it works here, Kai.
lines.zh: 你幫我寫好了我的信？在這裡不是這樣做的，凱。

story.en: Ms. Wong reads your draft. It says you are "the best employee in company history." She does not sign it.
story.zh: 王經理讀了你的草稿，上面寫著你是「公司史上最優秀的員工」。她沒有簽。

fail.why: 在英語職場，推薦信通常由推薦人親自撰寫，自己寫好請人簽名會顯得不尊重。可以主動提供資料：I can send you my résumé.。

lines.en: I'd be happy to. What's it for, and when do you need it?
lines.zh: 我很樂意。是要申請什麼？什麼時候需要？

choices.en: It's for a marketing job in Taipei. The deadline is in three weeks.
choices.zh: 是台北的行銷職缺，截止日在三週後。
choices.tip: 清楚說明用途和期限，並給對方足夠時間（give enough notice），是請推薦信的基本禮貌。

choices.en: It's for a marketing job in Taipei. The deadline is tomorrow, sorry.
choices.zh: 是台北的行銷職缺，明天截止，抱歉。

lines.en: Tomorrow? Kai, a good letter takes time. I have three meetings today.
lines.zh: 明天？凱，一封好的推薦信需要時間。我今天有三個會。

story.en: Ms. Wong writes it at midnight. It's three sentences long, and one of them is "Kai works here."
story.zh: 王經理半夜趕出來了。信只有三句，其中一句是「凱在這裡工作」。

fail.why: 請人寫推薦信，習慣上至少提前兩到三週通知（give enough notice）。臨時拜託會讓對方很為難，信的品質也會受影響。

choices.en: It's in Taipei! Have you ever been? The night markets are amazing.
choices.zh: 在台北！您去過嗎？夜市超棒的。

lines.en: I have, yes. But... what's the letter for? And when?
lines.zh: 去過啊。不過……信是要申請什麼？什麼時候要？

story.en: You talk about stinky tofu for ten minutes. Ms. Wong's next meeting starts before you mention the deadline.
story.zh: 你聊了十分鐘臭豆腐。王經理的下一個會議開始了，你還沒講到截止日。

fail.why: 主管問 What's it for, and when? 時，要直接回答用途和期限。閒聊可以留到事情談完後。

lines.en: Three weeks is plenty. Is there anything you'd like me to highlight?
lines.zh: 三週很充裕。有什麼希望我特別提到的嗎？

choices.en: If possible, the café chain pitch. I learned a lot from that one.
choices.zh: 可以的話，提一下連鎖咖啡店的提案。那次我學到很多。
choices.tip: If possible, ... 委婉提出希望，再說明理由，讓推薦人有具體素材可寫。

choices.en: Anything is okay. I trust you, so you see how to do it.
choices.zh: 什麼都可以，我相信您，您看著辦。

lines.en: "You see how to do it"? So... you want me to guess?
lines.zh: You see how to do it？所以……你要我用猜的？

story.en: Ms. Wong writes a nice but very general letter. It could describe almost anyone who has ever worked in an office.
story.zh: 王經理寫了一封客氣但很籠統的信，幾乎可以套用在任何上過班的人身上。

fail.why: 「您看著辦」直譯 you see how to do it 英文說不通，也沒提供素材。可以說 If possible, could you mention...?

choices.en: Maybe the café pitch? I hope you can mention about my presentation.
choices.zh: 也許是咖啡店提案？希望您能提到我的簡報。

lines.en: Mention about? Just "mention," Kai. But yes, I can do that.
lines.zh: Mention about？只要說 mention 就好，凱。不過可以，我會寫。

story.en: Ms. Wong agrees, then adds "still working on prepositions" to her mental notes. Hopefully not to the letter.
story.zh: 王經理答應了，然後在心裡記下「介系詞還要加強」。希望不會寫進信裡。

fail.why: mention 是及物動詞，後面直接接受詞：mention my presentation，不加 about。同類的還有 discuss、describe。

lines.en: Consider it done. I'll send it to you by next Friday.
lines.zh: 包在我身上。下週五前寄給你。

choices.en: Thank you so much. I really appreciate everything you've taught me.
choices.zh: 非常謝謝您。我真的很感激您教我的一切。
choices.tip: I really appreciate... 比 Thank you 更正式、更有份量，適合感謝主管。

choices.en: Great, thanks. Please don't forget, okay? It's really important.
choices.zh: 太好了，謝謝。請不要忘記喔，真的很重要。

lines.en: I've managed this team for twelve years, Kai. I think I'll remember.
lines.zh: 我管這個團隊十二年了，凱。我想我記得住。

story.en: Ms. Wong sends the letter on Wednesday, two days early, with a short note: "As promised."
story.zh: 王經理星期三就寄出信，提早兩天，附上一句簡短的話：「如我所說。」

fail.why: 對答應幫忙的主管說「不要忘記」，聽起來像不信任對方。用感謝收尾：I really appreciate it.。

choices.en: Thank you! I'll bring you a really nice, expensive gift to say thanks.
choices.zh: 謝謝！我會送您一份很好、很貴的禮物答謝。

lines.en: Expensive? Please don't, Kai. A thank-you card is more than enough.
lines.zh: 很貴的？千萬不要，凱。一張感謝卡就很夠了。

story.en: You show up with a fancy gift box anyway. Ms. Wong has to explain the company's gift policy to you. Twice.
story.zh: 你還是帶了精美禮盒出現。王經理只好跟你解釋公司的收禮規定，講了兩次。

fail.why: 在英語職場，送主管貴重禮物可能讓人尷尬，甚至違反公司規定。真誠的感謝或一張卡片就很得體：I really appreciate it.。

lines.en: You've earned it, Kai. Taipei will be lucky to have you.
lines.zh: 這是你應得的，凱。台北能有你是他們的運氣。

story.en: You asked politely, gave plenty of notice, and offered something real to write about. The letter that arrives next Friday makes you read it twice.
story.zh: 你有禮貌地請託、給足時間，還提供具體素材。下週五收到的那封信，讓你忍不住讀了兩遍。

notes.en: I was wondering if you'd be willing to...
notes.explain: 請託時最客氣的句型。用過去式 was wondering 和 would 讓語氣更委婉，適合對主管、老師使用。

example.en: I was wondering if you'd be willing to look at my résumé.
example.zh: 不知道您是否願意幫我看一下履歷。

notes.explain: 打擾別人前先確認對方有空，再預告 I have a favor to ask.，對方會更願意聽。

example.en: Do you have a minute? I have a quick question.
example.zh: 你有空嗎？我有個小問題。

notes.explain: 請人寫推薦信，習慣上至少提前兩到三週，並主動提供履歷、職缺內容和截止日。推薦信由推薦人自己寫，不要自己代筆請人簽名。

example.en: The deadline is in three weeks, so there's no rush.
example.zh: 截止日在三週後，所以不急。

notes.explain: mention 後面直接接受詞，不加 about。中文「提到關於」容易讓人多加 about。discuss、describe 也一樣。

example.en: Could you mention my teamwork skills?
example.zh: 可以請您提一下我的團隊合作能力嗎？

notes.explain: 比 Thank you 更正式。後面接名詞或 everything you've done，常用來感謝主管、導師。

example.en: I really appreciate your help with the project.
example.zh: 很感謝你在這個專案上的幫忙。
